brentwood-school-safeguarding-review-bri.h: Brentwood School coach Gareth Stafford Bull likely abused pupils, review finds
brentwood-school-safeguarding-review-bri.s: Former pupils who raised concerns years later were brushed off, the report says, and British Fencing is now setting up its own inquiry into what was known.

c2c-best-in-britain-to-not-good-enough-i.h: From best in Britain to below standard: what's going wrong at c2c
c2c-best-in-britain-to-not-good-enough-i.s: c2c topped Britain's punctuality table last spring. This autumn, just over half its stops have been on time. We look at why.

clacton-essex-petition-prison-drivers-co.h: Clacton 8th in UK for signing petition to jail drivers who hide crashes
clacton-essex-petition-prison-drivers-co.s: The petition wants mandatory prison for drivers who hide a crash or hold up a police investigation. Essex has under 3% of the UK's constituencies but about 7% of its signatures.

colchester-food-hygiene-ratings-0-1-fsa-.h: Three Colchester food outlets hold hygiene ratings of 0 or 1
colchester-food-hygiene-ratings-0-1-fsa-.s: A High Street restaurant has the lowest rating, zero, and two other city centre businesses are rated one after inspections in October, an analysis of Food Standards Agency data by The Seax shows.

essex-house-prices-september-2026-maldon.h: Maldon house prices up 5% in a year as Tendring's fall 2.2%
essex-house-prices-september-2026-maldon.s: Official September figures show a county split in two. Prices rose in nine Essex areas and fell in five.

essex-oyster-farmers-eu-trade-uk-eu-deal.h: Essex oyster exports lost to Brexit could return under UK-EU deal
essex-oyster-farmers-eu-trade-uk-eu-deal.place: West Mersea, Blackwater, Colne, Crouch and Roach
essex-oyster-farmers-eu-trade-uk-eu-deal.s: Since 2021 the EU has refused oysters from most Essex waters unless they are purified first, a Seax analysis shows. The new UK-EU deal is expected to end that from March 2028.

essex-recorded-crime-september-2026-poli.h: Essex anti-social behaviour reports up 76% as robbery falls 19%
essex-recorded-crime-september-2026-poli.s: The Seax analysis of police.uk data shows anti-social behaviour reports rose in 50 of Essex Police's 56 neighbourhood areas in September 2026 compared with September 2025, with Basildon recording the most.
